compounddef.title: AnalysisG — A Graph Neural Network Analysis Framework for High Energy Physics

sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: AnalysisG is a high-performance analysis framework that translates CERN ROOT n-tuples into graph-structured data, trains and evaluates Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), and supports cut-based selections. It is written in C++20 with CUDA extensions and exposed to Python via Cython.

entry.para: Coloured terminal logging and progress-bar utilities.
File-system, string and math utility base class.
ROOT sample management and multi-threaded reading.
Batched data delivery to GNN training loops.
DSID lookup and data-scraping via AMI.
Self-contained C++/CUDA HEP kernels (ΔR, pT, η, φ, m, ν-reco, …).

sect1.title: Python CUDA (pyc) Sub-package
sect1.para: The pyc sub-package provides fully batched CUDA/C++ implementations of common HEP operations via the LibTorch API:

listitem.para: pyc::physics — relativistic kinematics (|p|², pT, η, φ, m, ΔR).
pyc::nusol — analytical single and double neutrino reconstruction.

sect1.title: Architecture Overview
sect1.para: The framework follows a pipeline architecture:

listitem.para: I/O Layer: io and sampletracer read ROOT files via data_t/element_t, producing event_template objects populated with particle_template collections.
Graph Layer: graph_template transforms event objects into graph_t instances containing PyTorch tensors. The topology predicate and feature getters are defined by the user in CompileEvent().
Selection Layer: selection_template receives the same events and applies user-defined cuts, optionally writing output ROOT branches.

Training Layer: dataloader batches graph_t objects; model_template subclasses implement the GNN forward pass and loss computation; optimizer wraps the PyTorch optimiser/scheduler; k-fold cross-validation is coordinated by analysis.
Metrics Layer: metric_template and metrics accumulate per-epoch loss, accuracy, and invariant-mass histograms.
Utility Layer: notification (coloured logging), tools (filesystem/strings/math), and cproperty (computed property mechanism) are inherited throughout.

sect1.para: The analysis class is the top-level orchestrator that chains all layers together.

sect1.title: Read the Docs
sect1.para: Documentation is hosted on Read the Docs and rebuilt automatically on every push. The full pipeline is defined in .readthedocs.yaml.
